instructions: Original AI-authored challenging practice inspired by topics and style in the available teacher quizzes. Not a teacher paper or official mark scheme. Work independently under timed conditions; self-mark against the model points after submission.
description: Timed teacher-inspired mock with written answers and model marking points.

questions.text: A sound recording is sampled at 44,100 samples per second using 16 bits per sample, mono, for 10 seconds. Calculate its size in bytes, ignoring headers.
Explain two effects of increasing colour depth.

answer.text: More bits per pixel allow more possible colours

questions.text: Explain why a logical right shift of an unsigned binary number usually divides it by two. State a limitation.

answer.text: Bits move one position right, halving their place values
A discarded 1 causes rounding down; high-order zeros fill the gaps

questions.text: Explain how run-length encoding compresses suitable image data.

answer.text: Repeated consecutive values are stored as a value and count
Long runs are compressed well; irregular data may not compress
